inputs.prompt: <Video 1> <Picture 1> <Picture 2> <Picture 3> In a modest Chinese apartment in soft daylight, a small folding dining table with two wooden chairs, a window with a pale curtain, a thermos, a bowl and a small covered pot on a low sideboard, the table and the chairs and the window arranged as in the reference <Picture 3>. A Chinese woman in her late fifties with the same face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 1>, short dark hair with silver streaks, wearing a plain dove-grey knit cardigan. An elderly Chinese man aged seventy-two with the same face exactly matching the reference portrait <Picture 2>, neat short silver-grey hair, slim round black-framed glasses, wearing a soft beige knit sweater over a light blue collared shirt. Over the course of the shot, in one continuous slow gentle sequence: the woman walks the short distance over to him with unhurried steps and stops beside his chair, slowly reaches out one hand and gently presses the top edge of the newspaper downward, the newspaper gradually lowering in his hands until his face is revealed above it; he slowly lifts his head and looks up at her over the lowered newspaper, and she pauses with a very small quiet amused smile as if she has forgotten what she was going to say. By the end of the shot the newspaper is still open and still held in both of his hands, now resting low enough that his whole face is visible, the woman is standing beside his chair with her hand drawn back to her own side, both of them are quiet together in the soft daylight, and the table, the two chairs, the window, the thermos, the bowl and the covered pot are unchanged in the same positions. Throughout the shot the newspaper never disappears, never floats away, never changes shape, never turns into another object and is never placed on the table; it stays in his two hands from the first frame to the last and only its height changes.
